# M2 qualification cases

[中文](README_cn.md) · [Gate plan](../../../docs/island/m2-qualification.md)

`cases.json` freezes 28 ordered M2 boundaries. `check_cases.py` validates IDs, phase coverage, owner dependencies, deferred R02/R03/R05 boundaries, P07's merged TODO state and bilingual guide links. Run `python3 tests/fixtures/m2_qualification/check_cases.py` from the EOS root. This checker validates the fixture and documentation; executable behavior is verified by `tests/m2_cross_repo_replay.py` and the six-batch `tests/run_m2_qualification.sh` wrapper, with complete output under ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`.

An executor should create one isolated home per mutation class, pin full repository commits and selected binaries, preserve raw response/status snapshots in private logs, and compare saved bytes, active revision and child PIDs before and after rejected operations. M2-21 has two evidence layers: replacing `cursor-state.json` with a directory after Apply makes public Run return `log_scope_publish_failed` before child spawn; IsOS owner unit tests separately inject failure before save and simulated uncertainty after a successful rename, then check the surviving new run and unavailable anchor. The public mutation is a blocked state path, and the owner simulation does not cause an actual parent-directory fsync syscall to fail. M2-27 is a public Apply/Run case: an uninstalled 0.1.0 pin fails P01 with `package_missing_file` at the process `/package`. M2-28 is a separate IsOS unit predicate case, runnable with `cargo test --no-default-features --bin isos contributed_type_needs_exact_catalog_pin`; its injected 0.1.0 catalog triggers `reader_package_pin_mismatch` against a 0.1.1 graph, a mismatch the public selected-pin catalog path cannot construct. Report each case as pass, fail or blocked by its named dependency; do not record R02/R03/R05 as a passed M2 assertion.
